title: research: trace V45 recovery and price the remaining margin
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The bounded V45 comparison finds no new fully costed improvement to #2979. It explains where the apparent extra recovery went: PR2894 and PR2917 already have the same four algebraic directions on the fixed twelve-register readout U12. The later paid frames make them accessible; after the four PR2942 extractions, every coefficient from a fresh eligible input in U12 is zero. PR2979 retains that exact map.

This package adds the complete before/after coefficient comparison for both providers at five pinned stages, a written nonlinear consequence over every dyadic module, and an exact necessary cost screen. It distinguishes algebraic readouts from shipped literal V45 supports. In the old readout, a dyadic-unit completion identifies the quotient by nuisance inputs with the four existing quantities. In the later readout, the zero eligible block excludes any nonconstant fresh eligible-input function under arbitrary nonlinear decoding or eligible-only recoding. The stated suffix extension fixes the complete dependency graph, output identities, monotone frames, entrance cut and source-access contract.

At PR2979's rational complex parameter, all 2,551 fixed-bin dual patterns certify the marginal fractional idle charge `D=(H48-H3-5H5)/20`. A hypothetical fresh 9-to-7 extraction has only about `0.0246870954232` tariff units per call left for its extra local charge, plus the separately stated old fractional allocation slack. This is a necessary screen, not a physical invoice or a new outer κ. No candidate survives the information comparison, so this bounded route stops before construction expansion.

The result does not establish optimality of the existing four-direction implementation or exclude changed middles, other cuts, incomparable endpoint combinations, or changed source access. It does not replay PR2979's exploratory lowering search, whose local dependencies are absent.

## Task and overlap

User-assigned follow-up to #3172 under `complex-new-helper-inventory`, with the scope change recorded in `TASK.json`: exact transfer and a decisive scoped negative result, rather than the card's positive supplier acceptance gate. Canonical main and guidance were refreshed unchanged at 2026-10-17 14:52 UTC, base `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`, priority revision 6.

Canonical coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18970763

Nearest work: #2918/#3172 fixed-word obstruction; #2917/#2942/#2979 existing V45 constructions; #3014 frozen-owner negative; #3112/#3119/#3126 native/invoice audits. Their results and credit are retained. The separate active #3133/#3148 whole-word investigation is outside this comparison. Presubmission overlap scan covered all 295 open PR bodies and 1,956 discussion records with complete pagination, plus relevant local notes/ledger; it was not a review of every diff or external literature.

## Validation

Commit `9c0399238a0a93defb7123799978bfb33689396b` adds only `research/v45-recovery-transfer/` (12 files). Fourteen live inputs have SHA256/Git-blob pins; all eight provider copies were checked against their original scientific heads.

- CPython 3.12.12 registered replay: `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/v45-recovery-transfer` — `PASS_V45_RECOVERY_TRANSFER` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`.
- Separately implemented reverse-covector/inverse-column and finite-span checker, importing no predecessor Python, agrees on every U12 coefficient, complete bases, pairing entries, frames and minors.
- Exact cost basis inversion and all 2,551 dual patterns; eleven named rejection controls, four noncommuting fixtures, and six detected development sensitivity mutations.
- Source-identical Git-free isolated optimized CPython 3.14.6 replay passes with the same stored result.
- `python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/v45-recovery-transfer` — `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` for all 26 package/input files at the committed head; `git diff --cached --check` passed before commit.
- Separate source/compliance, cost, mathematical and independent-verifier reviews found no unresolved defect within the declared scope. These were AI-assisted reviews, not independent human or formal-kernel review.

No full native chain, new chronological owner construction, physical invoice, selected cold replay or new κ is claimed. Hosted CI is separate from local evidence; no manual check rerun or no-op retrigger was requested.

Nick Petalas and jwr404's existing audits delimit overlap. The retained owner/native lineage includes Yiyang Lu, Tekalign, icekylinx, Dugongue, themilkman216 and the frozen packages' contributors. The authenticated PR2918 forward engine is reused unchanged; the new reverse checker and exact cost basis/dual code are separately implemented. New comparison and proof by Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The underlying quotient and linear-programming principles are standard.

## Open next questions

Can a changed middle, changed observation cut, or cheaper realization of the four already-used directions beat the complete cost? The next useful step is an exact changed program with paired residual, compensation/restoration proof, and complete local histogram screened against an applicable bound. Any private-buffer, chronological-owner, native, stock, precision and outer-admission costs remain explicit obligations. Repeating nonlinear decoding on unchanged U12 cannot supply a fifth fresh helper.
